name: XlLinkedDataTypeState
description: Indicates the state of cells that may contain Linked data types such as Stocks or Geography. These are the possible values of the Range.LinkedDataTypeState property.

constants.name: xlLinkedDataTypeStateNone
constants.description: The cell does not contain any Linked data types.

constants.name: xlLinkedDataTypeStateValidLinkedData
constants.description: The cell contains a Linked data type.

constants.name: xlLinkedDataTypeStateDisambiguationNeeded
constants.description: The cell needs to be disambiguated by the user before a Linked data type can be inserted. For example, if the user types "New York" into a cell and attempts to convert it to a "Geography" data type, they may need to select whether they meant New York State or New York City. Until they do so, the cell will be in this state.

constants.name: xlLinkedDataTypeStateBrokenLinkedData
constants.description: There is a valid Linked data type in the cell, but entity no longer exists on the service.

constants.name: xlLinkedDataTypeStateFetchingData
constants.description: The Linked data type in the cell is in the middle of refreshing new data from the service.
